panels.title: Órdenes rechazadas, vencidas, con timeout o error

targets.rawSql: SELECT expedida, id, tipo, estado, motivo, usuario, correlacion FROM ordenes_control WHERE estado IN ('Rechazado','Vencido','Timeout','Error') AND expedida > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY expedida DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', expedida) AS time, count(*) AS fallos FROM ordenes_control WHERE estado IN ('Rechazado','Vencido','Timeout','Error') AND expedida > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
